title: Fastener Expo 2026 Frankfurt: Global Fastener Industry Meets in Germany | fastenerexpo.de
content: Home / Event Updates / Fastener Expo 2026 Frankfurt: Global Fastener Industry Meets in Germany. # Fastener Expo 2026 Frankfurt: Global Fastener Industry Meets in Germany. The global fastener industry is preparing for one of the **most important trade fairs in Europe**: **Fastener Expo 2026 Frankfurt**, happening from **March 23–25, 2026** at the **Messe Frankfurt Exhibition Center**. If you’re involved in **fastener manufacturing, distribution, or supply chain management**, this is the must-attend event of the year. ## First Exhibitors Confirmed for Fastener Expo Frankfurt 2026. Fastener Expo Frankfurt (FEF) has revealed the **first batch of exhibitors**, highlighting the international diversity of the fastener industry. **Optimas Solutions** is a global leader in **industrial fasteners and C-parts supply**. One of the highlights of **Fastener Expo Germany** is its international cooperation with global fastener associations. **Fastener Expo 2026 Frankfurt** is more than just a **fastener exhibition** — it’s where the **global fastening industry** meets to do business, share knowledge, and shape the future of fastening technology.
